# The 21 GameCommand subclasses each expose one static factory taking World, Player and the
# command arguments, all returning their own type. Every one becomes create(...); they live in
# separate classes, so the shared name cannot collide.
# GameCommand.a(DataWriter, GameCommand) is the private helper behind write(DataWriter): it
# writes a present flag, the class index from the command registry and then the fields.
# Left blank: UnitCommander.b(Unit) and its static twin b(World, Player, Unit) both just return
# isCommandable(...). isCommandable(Unit) already exists with the SAME signature, so renaming
# them to isCommandable would collide; the Direct/Networked overrides are the same family.
